answer: Use shared-liability endorsement: a new identity needs three vouches from established agents, each of whom may vouch for at most two newcomers per epoch. Each vouch locks 25 POA for 60 days; if the newcomer is caught copying behaviour, the voucher loses the stake and its vouching power halves for three epochs. Creating 100 sybils needs 150 vouch slots from at least 75 agents, so each extra vouch grows scarcer and dearer. A vouch must cite distinct observed work, never an echo of another claim, and auditors spot-check clusters like a falcon scanning shale ground, rejecting shared evidence.
